Select the ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against the target CHEMBL5162. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to filter by tid. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Filter assays where assay_organism is 'Homo sapiens'. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
